
'''Mumble''' is a program frequently used for voice communication in Lojbanistan. It is free software that runs on Windows, OS X and Linux and provides encryption and good sound quality via speex. To get started, install the [http://mumble.sf.net/ umble client] and connect to a server listed below.

It is a good idea to announce your presence on Mumble to the community, perhaps on [[jbocre: Lojban I|IRC]] or other [[jbocre: Lojbanic F|Forums]], either in advance or when you're ready to start chatting.

In fact, some lessons are given by means of Mumble, inquire in #ckule to get in on them.
